Order 
Heard on IA No. 1456/2023, an application under Section 5 of the Limitation Act.
2. For the reasons stated in the application, same is allowed and delay in filing misc. appeal is hereby condoned.

3. This appeal by the appellant/claimant u/S. 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is arising out of the award dated 06.08.2022 passed by Third Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (in short "Claims Tribunal") Joura, District Morena (M.P.) in Claim Case No.136/2019 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.
4. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in question.

5. As per findings of the Claims Tribunal, in the case of injury sustained by Shivdayal in motor accident, an amount of compensation to the tune of Rs.1,92,716/- has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal with interest from filing of claim petition till its realization.
6. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Claims Tribunal has committed NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:7899 2 MA-1705-2023 grave error in awarding the amount.

He further submits that Claims Tribunal has awarded the compensation is on lower side and, hence, it Shivdayal Sharma vs Shanti Lal Rawat on 6 March, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/11518195/
1 is prayed that compensation amount be enhanced and just and reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.
7.

entities.text: Shivdayal Sharma vs Shanti Lal Rawat
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company contended that the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is just and proper and needs no enhancement.
He supported the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal and prays for dismissal of the appeal.

8. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the record as well as looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly the injuries sustained by claimant, it would be appropriate to enhance compensation to the tune of Rs.1,00,000/-
9.
Accordingly, present appeal is allowed in part to the extent indicated herein above.
The amount of compensation is enhanced to lump sum amount of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh Only) in the present appeal.
The appellant is entitled to receive Rs.1,00,000/- in addition to the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
It is made clear that appellants/claimants are not entitled to get interest from 25.10.2022 to 17.03.2023.
All other findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
10. The present appeal stands disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE *AVI*
